summary: Base $25->$35: the $25 sites are hike-in tent sites, every RV site has electric at $35; electric surcharge cleared; added $31 off-peak. Added 50-amp no W/S, 53 sites to 79 ft (17 pull-through), vault toilets/water/dump/store, year-round (ReserveOhio), deep link, 6-month window, 14-night max.
flags: Phone missing: (740) 887-4818. ODNR says the park office is 'Located at Tar Hollow State Park', and this is the number on both the park and campground pages.

PIN in the water: 39.2285,-82.9525 falls on Caldwell Lake, 381 m from the sites' centroid and 278 m from the nearest. Corrected coords: 39.23064,-82.95595 (centre of the 53 sites' ReserveOhio coordinates).

WATERFRONT RE-AUDIT LEAD (stored lakeview): the evidence says electric sites 41-55 'loop around small Caldwell Lake', but ReserveOhio's coordinates put 41-55 about 110-300 m north of the lake on a side road, and 1-40 in a line west of it. On leaf-off imagery the closest pads are 10-13, about 70-90 m from the lake's north-west tip across the beach road; none faces it from a row on the shore. ODNR: 'wooded campground near Caldwell Lake'. Not changed; the lakeview call looks generous for most sites, and the evidence's site reference is contradicted. Worth a re-audit.
No SPLIT: Stewart Lake camp (1.2 km south) is hike-in tent only.
Website line has the park page; the campground's own page is https://ohiodnr.gov/go-and-do/plan-a-visit/find-a-property/scioto-trail-state-park-campground.
